judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: Shop barks with casual slang ('Wanna buy a potion?'), a run-on with missing punctuation ('choose quick the bandits took...'), and a slightly awkward 'met both [Person] at the gate and our Mayor' read like unpolished 1999 game copy; a modern writer would rarely leave the unpunctuated line.
